title: SSE: incomplete UTF-8 sequence at raw_buf head silently dropped
description: When valid_up_to==0 and error_len==None (multi-byte sequence arrives with first byte alone in a chunk), the code does drain_end = valid_up_to.max(1) = 1, dropping the start byte. Next chunk sees orphaned continuation bytes, silently discarding the character. Trigger: HTTP chunk boundary falls exactly after the first byte of a 2-4 byte UTF-8 codepoint in SSE data (e.g. any non-ASCII character in JSON payload). Bad behavior: character silently dropped without error, producing malformed JMAP data. Fix: only drain when error_len is Some (definitely invalid); when error_len is None (incomplete), leave the head in raw_buf and wait for the next chunk.
